2602.title: Project command scanner skips in-project file aliases
2602.rootCauseOneLine: The Markdown walker skips symbolic entries before file eligibility; readable in-project aliases disappear while identical regular replacements appear.
2602.proposedFix: Resolve eligible leaf aliases within the defined project boundary and add command-specific regression coverage.
caveats: No live slash UI or provider execution.
Existing3856 skill-directory evidence preserved, not rerun.
Linux filesystem only; no outside-project or directory-link behavior tested.
